a_bad_day_for_everyone: Non-canon. Sanya drags a leashed, collared Emmett out of the ship on a "special mission" to a roadside diner, with a suspicious Garrick trailing behind.
a_beginning: Sanya wakes from a nightmare of her slaughtered crew and a monstrous hunter, then asks KYL300 for a name for the emotion that followed her out of the dream.
a_conversation_between_gods: In another bloody dream of the ship, Sanya finds Dread waiting by the pool, with an unexpected explanation of what their shared bond has cost them both.
a_fateful_date: Sanya lays out a hunter's feast in a glowing blue fern grove for a night alone with Mary, but her Floran urges and an unfamiliar feeling complicate the evening.
a_precarious_encounter: Banned from grass and watched around the clock, Emmett seizes one unguarded night to sneak off the ship and meet a stranger from a dating app.
a_quick_break: Rattled by how badly her last job went, Sanya spends a break researching at her temple with Mary, then calls in a favor from Garrick.
a_wonderful_family_reunion: Four years after running away, Zach is returned to his father John's mansion on Earth, and must find a way off the planet before he is shut away for good.
aftermath_of_an_assassination: Emmett wakes up beside Jess after the crew's payday and tries to apologize for the night before, while Sanya, Garrick and Volentina plot a prank at his expense.
airlocked: Emmett finally confronts Seth about the junk stashed in the ship's navigation system, and Seth answers with the airlock. What follows leaves him adrift, armed and facing the Llamanians.
an_awakening: Matieu, one of the Righteous Few descended from Kluex, watches helplessly as Kluex takes the wheel of his body, and starts plotting to turn that power to his own ends.
any_means_necessary: In a dark warehouse, three armored Ravens, Odran, Sascha and their leader, take stock of a fallen comrade and vow to wipe out whoever is responsible.
ballistic_bonanza: Playback from Kari, a Jade Rabbit mercenary android, who walks into a Zomania jazz bar to collect a Llamanian bounty on Oldra. The plan is simple, but the patrons disagree.
bellow_and_zach_train: Zach teaches Bellow swordfighting with sticks on a forest planet, and the lessons slowly turn into quiet talks about home, old crews and what happened on Barbona.
bellows_journal_and_audio_logs: Bellow Brightlight's journal entries and audio logs, kept across the Horizoners' missions, tracking his friendship with Dutch and a crew under growing strain.
chomskys_journal_audio_logs: Victor Chomsky's private journal and audio logs from aboard the pirate ship, as a stranded arsonist with a secret agenda studies the crew he has joined.
cold_comfort: Zion's log from five days into being stranded on a frozen planet, with a sealed airlock, a garbled radio and a crew that is starting to come apart.
cultural_spotlight: Ryanne Deer's Channel 14 News crew expects a tidy cultural spotlight on Domoleáin, but ends up following Bonacco McGulch and the Sanverde St. Firm through sport, pubs and brawls.
deafening_silence: Zion Daybreaker and Naomi, who grew up together, move from a treehouse promise of a better life to a bitter argument over what they owe the people who hurt them.
deep_pockets: Cleaning out his pocket dimension for the first time in years, Garrick finds a forgotten Ottori named Jess, a pulsing egg, and a statue he would rather not explain.
do_emmetts_dream_of_llamanian_sheep: A ship-wide blackout leaves Emmett on the end of Sanya's leash, and a feverish withdrawal dream pulls him into a surreal park of weddings, bees and old fears.
everything_was_okay: An ordinary inspection day at a KYL unit factory turns grim when the lights cut out and the blast doors close, with Wade hiding behind a conveyor belt.
final_pummel: Out of fuel and adrift in deep space, the Vortox Pummelers are boarded by the Llamanians who have hunted Emmett for years, as the crew's longest mission nears its end.
give_no_quarter: Odran and the Ravens' leader sit in the dark after a bruising defeat, puzzled by Sascha's survival and determined to hunt down the crew that beat them.
hesitation: Playback from a Jade Rabbit combat unit clearing a warzone city of Squoatlings, until one shot it cannot bring itself to take changes everything.
knocked_and_rocked_asleep: Knocked out aboard the ship, Zach wakes in a dark place between dreaming and dying, where a voice with red eyes asks what he dreads.
nehes_origin: Young Nehe, a Floran slave in a hidden military compound, clings to an old veteran's stories of the stars and a badge reading CPTN of the INTERSTELLAR DREAM.
obama_story: Non-canon. A deliberately absurd blooper reel written by the players while editing Final Pummel, in which the imprisoned crew drifts into memes, fast food and the author's own interference.
omg_zachs_gay_shocker: Hiding in a bar after his crew crashes their ship into a mall, Zach is approached by Jack Madison, a cheerful smuggler's driver who will not take silence for an answer.
one_whole_week: Stuck on a junk asteroid for a week, Sanya teleports to her private Floran temple for peace, only to find it overrun by marauders and one very unbothered stranger named Mary.
psychotherapy: Living quietly with Squina and Squorchy, Emmett gets visitors from the Llamanian Republic: his old friend Los, and a job offer that involves keeping Seth sane.
the_interviews: Non-canon. Emmett and Josephine, perhaps the last two Squoatlings, are hounded across Daerthlorn by news crews whose questions get more personal every time.
the_moon_comes_over_the_tower: Detective Daniel Whittaker arrives at the silent research station Skywatch-73 to find out why it stopped answering, and soon realizes he is not alone.
three_days: Zion's log of three dull days sailing an empty ocean on a Llamanian search mission, with an injured Dutch, a wandering Morra and a captain who stays absent.
wes_romaw_the_incident: A hired Anole sniper lies in wait above a packed racing stadium, with a contract on the top finishers and the final laps ticking down.
zachs_journey: From a mansion where his father despises his eyes to the deck of a pirate ship, Zach's life told in memories at ages five, ten, seventeen and beyond.
zombification: Twelve-year-old Squemfet gets a temporary permit to leave Vortox-56 and follows his author father to a foggy burial ground on Vortox-35.
